status: re-extracted and written 2026-08-30; no video tier; no community tier
note: Method lives in .claude/skills/consensus-guide/SKILL.md. This file records what is specific to Turkish: that the only tier-A source named no Turkish restaurant, and that the topic has a geography no ranking captures.

awardBodies.name: Harden's
awardBodies.note: THE ONLY INSPECTED SOURCE, AND IT CONTRIBUTED NOTHING ON THE FIRST PASS. hardens.com/restaurants/london/turkish/ is JS-rendered, so curl sees only the navigation - and the first pass recorded that navigation as 24 venues, every one of them tiered A. The topic's 18 tier-A citations were 'Harden's 100', 'Hot Newcomers', 'IOs / Android Apps', 'Corporate Gifts', '+ Over 3000 entries', and a 'you might also like' rail of City restaurants: Sweetings, Coq d'Argent, Brigadiers, Lutyens Grill, Cabotte, Cloth, Hispania, The Swan at the Globe. Not one is Turkish.
awardBodies.howToRead: READ IT IN THE BROWSER, not with curl. The real results are the elements with class .search_listing.result. There are five listings covering three restaurants: Haz (two branches), Haz Mincing Lane and Leydi, plus Baraka. Harden's Turkish coverage is genuinely this thin, which is itself the finding.

editorialLists.name: The Infatuation
editorialLists.note: The fullest source, 23 names with a verdict each in the page JSON-LD. Two street addresses and a byline are interposed as name fields and must be dropped.

editorialLists.name: Time Out
editorialLists.note: 19 names. It runs cuisine, area, a price meter and the photo credit into the copy with no separator, so a naive quote grab publishes 'Turkish Green Lanes price 2 of 4 Rob Greig' as if it were the verdict. The AREA in that run is worth keeping - Time Out is the only source that states where each restaurant is.

editorialLists.name: Resy
editorialLists.note: The longest list at 30 names, but its related-article titles were being captured as restaurants - 'How Charlie Sims and Honey Spencer Built Sune', '10 Superb London Tasting Menus Under GBP70'.

editorialLists.name: TB Mag
editorialLists.note: Turkish-British community magazine. Its captured names included the literal JavaScript fragment "+message+".

facetAxis.note: Turkish splits by GEOGRAPHY first and format second, which is unusual. Nine of the 27 restaurants named twice or more are on or just off Green Lanes; Dalston is the second cluster. No ranking captures that, and it is the single most useful thing to tell a reader.

knownGaps: NO AWARD EXISTS. No Michelin star, no annual category prize, nothing judged. Harden's lists three London restaurants under Turkish and that is the whole of the tier-A evidence. The article says so in its evidence block.
NO VIDEO TIER. Not collected. Worth a pass - Green Lanes is well covered by London food creators.
NO COMMUNITY TIER. Reddit is blocked to curl and to the browser pane.
Seven publications, where pizza has thirty-one. The corpus is small and the article should not be read as more than it is.
Only six of the 27 venues meeting the bar have a Restaurants v2 row, so there is no map.
openVenueQuestions: Mangal 1 and Mangal II are two separate Dalston restaurants, related by family and NOT merged. Recorded in data/name-aliases.json under deliberatelyNotAliased.

The '19 Numara Bos Cirrik' ocakbasi is written three ways across sources and has numbered siblings on the same stretch. Merged to one record; the numbered siblings are not distinguished and may be separate businesses.
21 of the 27 venues meeting the bar have no Restaurants v2 row, including Mangal II, The Counter, Yeni, Zahter and Haz.
